answer: Witness-Linked Registration. A new identity joins only when three existing members independently co-sign its first transaction, each posting a public attestation tied to their own history. Joining costs nothing; co-signing does. Every attestation permanently lowers the sponsor's future sponsorship budget by one slot and adds their name to a shared audit reef. If the newcomer later misbehaves, sponsors lose slots and rank. Attackers must therefore recruit many established members, not just pay fees. The lagoon of cheap clones never forms; honest growth spreads like a meadow, slow but rooted.
